# BuildRecordSource

The text of one source file of a recorded build, so the build can be re-opened or compared. It matches its `BuildRecordItem` by kind, name and file name.

**Kind:** an object, used in responses.

## Fields

Every field is present in a response; empty ones are `null`.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `kind` | [`BuildRecordFileKind`](build-record-file-kind.md) | Which part of the request the file was sent in. |
| `name` | `string` | The definition's name, as on the matching item. |
| `fileName` | `string \| null` | The file name the request gave; null for prompts and JSON files. |
| `content` | `string` | The file's text exactly as the server read it (lines joined with `\n`). |

## Example

```json
{
  "kind": "Agent",
  "name": "...",
  "fileName": "...",
  "content": "..."
}
```

## Where it's used

- Inside [`BuildRecord`](build-record.md)
